bridging_ideas.title: Earnings label is both the edge and the tail
bridging_ideas.gap: Earnings shock + Continuation issues via Market edge
bridging_ideas.idea: Split earnings spikes by shock strength; add relative dollar volume at the spike (thin = short covering, heavy = news continuation); use 10-K/8-K keyword flags as a pre-event veto; tag sector read-through so it does not pollute the no-catalyst bucket.
bridging_ideas.test: Earnings event, not strong positive, gap 0.25-1.0 ATR, normal relative volume, short, 20 min cover; run year by year on long history.

bridging_ideas.title: The deciding bars are the ones the feed drops
bridging_ideas.gap: Minute data + Trade losses via Broker errors
bridging_ideas.idea: Tail losers are decided in the first few 30-second bars, which is when IB throttles and errors. Precompute the shock flag pre-open from Massive so the veto never depends on live IB bars.
bridging_ideas.test: Skip or size down strong positive earnings shocks pre-open; compare PF with and without.

bridging_ideas.title: Gate the entry, not the exit
bridging_ideas.gap: Profit factor + Entry modifier via Broker errors
bridging_ideas.idea: Run speed (minutes to +5%) as an ATR-scaled gate; red = no entry, yellow = half size, no news = full size; IB never feeds the armed state.
bridging_ideas.test: Does the red/yellow gate plus run-speed gate lift holdout PF from ~0.95 toward 1.5?
